info.name: E-commerce Platform API
info.description:
REST API of the [e-commerce platform](https://github.com/AbubakrHamdy/ecommerce-platform): auth, catalog, cart, orders, Stripe/Paymob payments and admin reports.

**Setup**

1. `docker compose up -d`, then start the API with the `dev` profile (seed data and accounts).
2. Import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, and select the **E-commerce · local** environment.
3. Send anything: the collection signs in the seed customer and admin automatically.

**Folders**

- The first folders are a reference: one request per endpoint, with example bodies.
- The **Flow** folders are scenarios with tests. Run one (or the whole collection) with the Collection Runner; each flow sets up its own data.

Flows create orders and products in your dev database. Flow 2 needs Stripe test keys; Flows 1 and 4 read emails from Mailpit.

Registration, sign-in and token handling. Access tokens last 15 minutes; refresh tokens last 7 days and **rotate**: every refresh returns a new pair and the old refresh token stops working.

item.name: Admin: Orders
item.description:
Admin token required. Allowed status moves:

PENDING → PAID or CANCELLED · PAID → PROCESSING or CANCELLED · PROCESSING → SHIPPED or CANCELLED · SHIPPED → DELIVERED

Any other move returns 409. Cancelling puts the stock back.

query.description: PENDING, PAID, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED or CANCELLED

exec: pm.test('Moved, or 409 when the order is past PENDING', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 409]));

request.description: Change the body to the next status. Moves that the flow above doesn't allow return 409 with the reason.
